items.prompt: Two legitimate equal-size fills have different source-bound execution IDs. Should equal amounts alone deduplicate them?

options.text: Yes, every repeated amount is a duplicate
options.why: Equal numeric values can describe different executions.

options.text: Yes, if it makes PnL smaller
Only if the UI needs fewer rows
options.why: Display preference is not event identity.

options.text: No; identity is not merely payload size
options.why: Each real execution needs its own bound identity.

items.explanation: Avoid merging distinct events just because values happen to match.
